From \(f(\frac32-x)=f(x)\) and oddness:
\[
f(x+\tfrac32)=f(\tfrac32-(-x))=f(-x)=-f(x),
\]
so \(f(x+3)=f(x)\). Thus \(f\) has period \(3\), and \(f(0)=0\). Since \(f(-2)=-3\), oddness gives
\[
f(2)=3.
\]

For the sequence:
\[
\frac{S_n}{n}=2\frac{a_n}{n}+1 \implies S_n=2a_n+n.
\]
Then
\[
S_n-S_{n-1}=a_n \implies (2a_n+n)-(2a_{n-1}+n-1)=a_n,
\]
so
\[
a_n=2a_{n-1}-1.
\]
With \(a_1=-1\):
\[
a_5=-31,\quad a_6=-63.
\]
Using period \(3\):
\[
f(-31)=f(2)=3,\qquad f(-63)=f(0)=0.
\]
Therefore,
\[
f(a_5)+f(a_6)=3+0=3.
\]

\[
\boxed{3}
\]
